title: Observable exact-head Work Map post-write verification

phases.objective: Replace opaque post-write verification launches with observable REST dispatches and accept evidence only from workflow-dispatch runs whose head SHA exactly matches the Work Map writer result head, while preserving the current CI and Work Map Integration receiver contracts on main.

e2e_journeys.actor: Governed Work Map writer and repository verification workflows
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The sole governed writer completes generation, idempotency proof, commit, push, and exact remote branch-head readback.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: CI and Work Map Integration are dispatched through the Actions REST API on the target branch, their independent dispatch diagnostics are retained, and numeric run IDs are accepted only when each workflow_dispatch run reports head_sha equal to result_head_sha.
steps: Verify the remote work-branch head still equals result_head_sha immediately before verification dispatch.
Read CI and Work Map Integration workflow state and enable a disabled workflow before use.
Dispatch each receiver through its Actions REST dispatch endpoint on the exact target branch ref.
Persist independent stdout, stderr, and exit-code evidence for each dispatch.
Poll bounded workflow-dispatch run listings for the target branch and exact result_head_sha.
Fail closed unless both dispatch exit codes are zero and both exact-head numeric run IDs are observed.
Keep current CI receiver semantics that check out the pull-request head or workflow-dispatch event SHA.
Keep current Work Map Integration receiver semantics that check out its event SHA and resolve the unique same-repository open PR identity for workflow dispatch.
Publish V3 writer diagnostics containing the dispatch exits and exact verification run IDs.
Require the Pipeline Connectivity contract and all repository write-boundary regressions to reject legacy V2 opaque CLI verification dispatch.
assertions: The writer contains no gh workflow run call for CI or Work Map Integration verification.
The writer refuses stale branch movement before dispatch and filters observed runs by exact result_head_sha.

CI and Work Map Integration do not need stale branch/SHA input contracts because workflow_dispatch event SHA is the dispatched ref identity and the writer independently verifies the resulting run head SHA.
Pipeline governance requires V3 REST dispatch, dispatch exit codes, exact-head filtering, and numeric run identities and forbids V2/opaque dispatch signatures.
The repository write-boundary regression suite requires V3 markers and rejects V2 and gh workflow run verification signatures.
No direct main or Production mutation, force push, provider call, deployment, database mutation, migration Apply, credential payload read, external business send, or secret inclusion is introduced.

phases.objective: Correlate the writer result head and both verification run identities through repository-wide typed evidence surfaces.
Prove fail-closed behavior for branch movement, delayed workflow registration, disabled receivers, dispatch errors, and competing workflow-dispatch runs.
This repository verification change grants no provider canary authority.
This repository verification change grants no Production or deployment authority.
